common_stage1.audience: Northline Public Library director, program owner, and communications lead
common_stage1.communication_intent: Persuade the leadership team to approve the Night Shelf concept, pilot budget, scope, and measurement plan.
common_stage1.audience_outcome: The team can explain the audience tension, judge the concept against the evidence, and make the four-part approval decision.
common_stage1.core_message: Night Shelf turns an existing evening visit into one protected hour for leisure reading; approve a measured six-week pilot rather than treating the idea as a guaranteed growth claim.
common_stage1.delivery_context: Presenter-led 12-minute decision meeting, followed by reader-led review.
common_stage1.content_divergence: Re-architect freely for a persuasive narrative, but preserve every figure, qualifier, approved concept line, budget item, date, prohibition, and decision ask.

mode.behavior: Audience truth to tension to idea to touchpoint proof to pilot decision.

visual_style.behavior: Late-evening editorial system with restrained charcoal fields, warm amber emphasis, off-white text, and varied full-slide compositions. No fake photography or product UI.

generated_image_rendering.behavior: Not used; retain the direction only as a no-image editorial reference.
